content: Severe hypoglycemia has been independently linked to a decline in cognitive function as well as episodes of acute mental confusion. This relationship is especially concerning in younger individuals who have early-onset type 1 diabetes. In such cases, severe hypoglycemia can result in long-term impairments in cognitive abilities, including memory, attention, and problem-solving skills. These cognitive deficits are particularly significant as they can interfere with the individual’s ability to effectively manage their condition.
